parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center.

parameters.name: RamIdList
parameters.description: The RAM ID of the Cloud Call Center sub-account. Administrators can reset the status information of agents with instance failures. Skill group leaders can use this to reset the status information of agents with instance failures in their skill group. You can call the [ListUsers](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/63052.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.6.669.60a42ec43cAdOk) operation to query the RAM IDs. This parameter is active for resetting the status of abnormal agents in the corresponding scope.
